# Tech Stack

## AS IS — Current state

### Runtime and language

- **Language**: PHP ^8.3 (`composer.json`; Sail image runs 8.5)
- **Framework**: Laravel ^13.17

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| UI (owner panel) | Livewire ^4.4 (single-file components) |
| Admin | Filament ^5.0 |
| CSS/build | Tailwind ^4, `@tailwindcss/vite` ^4, Vite ^8, `laravel-vite-plugin` ^3.1 |
| DB | MySQL 8.4 (Sail); `database/database.sqlite` also present |
| Queue | `database` default (`config/queue.php`) |
| Billing | laravel/cashier ^16.8 |
| Storage | aws/aws-sdk-php ^3.397, league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3 ^3.0 |
| QR | chillerlan/php-qrcode ^5.0 |
| Local env | Laravel Sail (app, queue, MySQL, Mailpit); composer + npm |
| Dev tools | pail ^1.2.5, collision ^8.6, concurrently ^10.0.3, tinker ^3.0 |
| Formatter | pint ^1.27 (no `pint.json`) |

### Tests

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Runner | Pest ^4.7 + pest-plugin-laravel ^4.1 on PHPUnit ^12.5.12 |
| Assertions | Pest `expect()` + Laravel HTTP/Livewire assertions |
| Mocks | mockery ^1.6; hand fakes `tests/Fakes/{FakeMuxClient,FakeStripe,FakeVideoGenerationProvider}` |
| Coverage | not configured |
| Setup | `RefreshDatabase`, `withoutVite` (`tests/Pest.php`); `phpunit.xml`: QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync, MAIL_MAILER=array, CACHE_STORE=array, SESSION_DRIVER=array |
| Run | `composer test` (locally via `./vendor/bin/sail`) |

### External integrations

| System | Client wiring |
|---|---|
| Mux | `MuxClient` contract → `MuxApiClient`; `MUX_TOKEN_ID/SECRET/WEBHOOK_SECRET` |
| Stripe | Cashier; `STRIPE_KEY/SECRET/WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `CASHIER_CURRENCY` |
| Gemini Veo | `config/services.php` `gemini` (`GEMINI_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_VIDEO_MODEL`, `GEMINI_VIDEO_RESOLUTION`) |
| AWS S3 | `AWS_*`, `FILESYSTEM_DISK` |
| Mail | `MAIL_*` (Brevo/SMTP; Mailpit in Sail) |
